# Council International Representative

  * **[Quarterly Webinars](/international/international-representative/quarterly-webinars/)**
  * **[Position Description for Council International Representative](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/international/pdf/Council_IR_Position_Description.pdf)** _Let’s make sure our Scouts and their leaders know about the many opportunities of an International Scouting experience …_

  * [A Guide to International Scouting](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/10/International-Division_Boy-Scouts-of-America.pptx)

  * **International Camp Staff Program  ** _Bring an international Scout to your Council Summer Camp, boost the energy and excitement of your camp with the knowledge and diversity that international Scouts can bring to your staff and your camp …_

  * **[Jamboree On The Air (JOTA)](/jota) ** _An annual weekend event for your Scouts, a chance for Scouts of all ages to get connected with Scouts around the world using amateur radios …_

  * [**Jamboree On The Internet (JOTI)** ](https://www.scouting.org/joti) _An annual Scouting event sponsored by the World Scout Bureau. Scouts of all ages can make friends with many other Scouts and Scouters around the world, using the most current technology of communication …_
  * **[International Scouter’s Award](/international/recognitions) ** _Another great knot for your uniform! Your leadership and international experience deserve recognition …_
  * **[International Spirit Award](/international/recognitions) ** _A great opportunity to recognize all Scouting participants!_
  * [**International Web Passport**](/international/links) _Weblinks of International events, World Scouting, etc…._

  * **[World Friendship Fund](/international/world-support) ** _Find out how you and your friends can assist other Scouts in the world …._
  * **[World Scout Emblem Usage](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/08/World-Scout-Emblem-Usage.pdf) ** _When using the World Scout emblem on patches, shirts, or other items, be sure that you get the appropriate license…_

  * **[Council International Representative Nomination](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/IR-Nomination-form.pdf)**
